concepts.name: 余烬·折翼
concepts.design: Crimson and coral FOLDED-WING crossbow. Two broad angular limbs form a powerful swept shallow W, each made of three large overlapping thick trapezoidal wedges connected by a visible continuous structural spine. Hard stepped elbows, compact aggressively forward-hooked ends that hold the string, real substantial bow limb widths. A stout short angular receiver, clearly open bolt groove above it. Rear stock has one large triangular through-window and a solid butt, comfortable plain two-hand gripping positions. Tiny red triangular ember chips around the outer limb joints. Broad sculptural planes rather than delicate wire. Powerful compact crossbow silhouette.

concepts.name: 流萤·萦弧
concepts.design: Emerald and mint TWIN-ARC crossbow. Graceful wide crescent profile, left and right limb each a THICK elongated oval open frame tapering to outer string nock, two nested substantial bands create clear long negative spaces within each limb, physically connected at receiver and tips. Frames lie across the front of the crossbow horizontally; do not obscure long straight central bolt path. Three-dimensional curved ribbons with jade broad faces and mint edge lines. Slim but sturdy central stock gently arches at rear into a short teardrop open shoulder stock, straight hand-safe front grip and trigger grip. A handful of tiny mint crescent and dot particles drift in limb apertures. Calm elegant architectural flow, no plants or vines.

concepts.name: 寒汐·并轨
concepts.design: Deep blue and turquoise TWIN-RAIL crossbow. Long receiver is two thick parallel rectangular beams with a clearly exposed narrow bolt channel between them, joined by front and rear transverse blocks. Wide horizontal limbs at front are stepped squared reverse curves, each with exactly two stout prongs that rejoin at the outer string nock; a single taut luminous bowstring bent back to central latch. Low layered block silhouette, broad horizontal silhouette rather than a gun. Open underside visible between the rail beams, solid straight forward hand rest underneath. Angular short stock and wide beveled shoulder pad, no barrel or telescope. Sparse small cyan horizontal dash particles in the central rail slot and near outer limb ends. Rigid precise geometric clarity.

concepts.name: 梦隙·偏枢
concepts.design: Violet and lavender OFFSET-FRAME crossbow. Strong intentionally asymmetrical outer architecture: one bow limb a broad solid swept angular paddle with three descending steps, opposite limb an elongated open diamond truss built of two thick tapered beams. Both limbs end at equally distant balanced bowstring nocks connected by ONE taut V bowstring drawn back to center latch. Main straight bolt groove unobstructed. A thick partial octagonal frame sits offset beside and BELOW the central receiver, wraps into a sculptural thumbhole stock but never crosses the projectile line. This side frame is physically bolted into geometry with simple solid struts, no floating magic ring. A small attached faceted energy rhombus sits low in frame opening. Wide substantial crossbow limb span, long elegant receiver, two hand-safe grip areas. Sparse lavender diamond particles near the side frame. Distinctive asymmetry without spiky excess.
